requirements.text: Tighter safe base crop on every take; no black ceiling, floor, or white lower border in base framing; normalize subject scale before creative motion.
Richer natural subject-forward skin, contrast and presence; softer calmer less-dominant background; keep normalization, shot match and creative grade separate.
Bind restrained zooms, punch-ins, shakes and motion accents to authoritative master-audio musical/emotional events after safe framing.
